takenWith: plain git grep (-c for lines, -o for occurrences, -P patterns); comments are not stripped; two rules are tag scans and say so
scope: tracked files of the tree, frontend/src

legacy-type.note: class sites in .ts/.tsx. The plan quotes 615 (and 152 for the three renamed steps): those figures include 3 mentions in ui/tokens/tokens.css — see legacy-type-all-src.

legacy-variant.method: git grep -P for the lines, then the literals counted on each line
legacy-variant.note: literals on a line that names `variant` (attribute, expression or property). A literal on a LATER line of a multi-line expression is not seen here; legacy-variant-any-quoted-literal is the upper bound.

legacy-variant-any-quoted-literal.note: every quoted literal anywhere, including type unions and the recipe definitions — an upper bound, not a rule.

pressable-no-variant.method: tag scan (not a line grep): <Pressable …> opening tags with no variant attribute

pill-size.note: control() has no size axis at this commit, so every primary is "a primary with no size". Lines that name `variant` and the literal.

shaped-skeleton.method: tag scan (not a line grep): <Skeleton …> opening tags that carry a rounded-* class

reserved-surface-2-3.note: everywhere; the ratchet subtracts its allow-list (sheet, skeleton, disabled pill, switch track).

heading-icon.method: tag scan (not a line grep): <EmptyState …> / <SectionHeader …> opening tags that carry icon=

legacy-var.method: git grep -o -P, then grouped by the bridge table of plan-safe.md 2.3
legacy-var.note: occurrences = decoration + opaque + state + layout (the names the closing cleanup deletes). componentRevalued and muscleMap names stay declared with new values; they are listed so either reading can be summed. tokens.css itself is excluded, as in check-tokens.

var-usage-all-names.method: git grep -o -P (reference table, not a rule)
